canonical_statement: For a real-valued random variable X on a probability space with finite second moment, and every real r > 0, the probability of the closed event r <= |X - E[X]| is at most Var(X) / r^2.
domain_and_universes: universe u; Omega : Type u; MeasurableSpace Omega; P : Measure Omega; IsProbabilityMeasure P; X : Omega -> Real; r : Real; Prop in Lean universe 0
conclusion: P {omega | r <= abs (X omega - integral X dP)} <= ENNReal.ofReal (variance X P / r^2)
